issues.description: The template implementation of Farm.singFarmSongVerse declares no parameter (it is written as singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)), whereas the problem statement UML and the solution both define singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal). This mismatch means students must modify the method signature in the template to accept an Animal in order to implement singFarmSong() as intended (iterating animals and passing each to the verse method).
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template method signature to match the specification and solution: declare private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) and use the animal parameter inside the method. This aligns the template with the UML and the expected implementation, allowing students to implement singFarmSong() by iterating over the animals and calling singFarmSongVerse(animal).
